name: Drawdown Chart
when_to_pick: Show the underwater equity curve — how deep and how long each drawdown lasted. Use after the article has discussed the difference between average return and worst-case drawdown. Always renders below zero with red fill.

values.description: Drawdown values, 0 = no drawdown, negative = underwater (-25 means down 25%).

markers.description: Optional labelled dots anchored to x-axis points — e.g. peak, trough, recovery.

at.description: An x-axis label from `labels` to anchor the marker to.
